As if any secret can easily be revealed, the camera obscura will open up, all you need to do is put in some effort ... Let me explain, my friend. You have already poked around corporate territories, laboratories, offices, and all else. Those places have already been looted to the ground. But do you know where there still might be something interesting? In the offices of the wastewater treatment plant. Yes, that facility was also under TerraGroup. What do I want to find? Fact is, I don't even know myself yet. To begin with, let's try to find out what exactly TerraGroup was doing there. Contaminated water, chemical dump ten times over normal? Anything can open up. Prepare well - I hear there is unusually high activity in that area. Perhaps someone is guarding the territory against prying eyes.}} ==Requirements== *Must be level 17 to start this quest. ==Objectives== *Find the data on [[Water pump operation data|water pump operation]] *Hand over the extracted [[Water pump operation data|data]] *Find the data on [[Pumping station operation report|pumping station operation]] *Hand over the extracted [[Pumping station operation report|data]] ==Rewards== *+8,000 [[EXP]] *[[Mechanic]] Rep '''+0.02''' *40,000 Roubles **42,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1 **46,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2 * Unlocks purchase of [[Kalashnikov AK-104 7.62x39 assault rifle]] (variant RPKT mod.1) at [[Ref]] LL2 * Unlocks purchase of [[DevTac Ronin ballistic helmet]] at [[Mechanic]] LL2 {{Quote|So there were some documents? Give'em to me. Let's see ... Stationery delivery, office rent - nothing interesting so far... There it is, chemicals. The "BLUE ICE" traces in the water? What is this, some kind of refrigerant? Alright, I'll deal with this, but for now, take yourself a small gift for your efforts. Thanks again, friend.}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Related Quest Items |- !Icon !Item name !Amount !Requirement !Find in raid !Notes |- |[[File:Water pump operation data icon.png|frameless|64px|link=Water pump operation data]] |[[Water pump operation data]] |1 |Handover item !Yes | rowspan="2" |''This [[Quests#Quest items|quest item]] can only be found if the quest is active.''
